steps: Create a Meta developer app and add the Instagram product with Instagram API setup with Instagram login
Add the Instagram professional (Business or Creator) account as a tester or role user; Instagram needs a professional account
Register the redirect URI below under the Instagram business login settings
Store the Instagram app id and secret: switchboard vault set ig_app_id and switchboard vault set ig_app_secret
Register them: switchboard authconfig add meta-instagram --client-id-ref ig_app_id --client-secret-ref ig_app_secret
notes: Observed 2026-10-23 (Meta Instagram business login doc): authorize at https://www.instagram.com/oauth/authorize; the code is exchanged with POST https://api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token (client_id, client_secret, grant_type, redirect_uri, code) and the answer wraps the token in a data array; the short-lived token is traded at GET https://graph.instagram.com/access_token with grant_type=ig_exchange_token for a 60 day token, and refreshed at GET https://graph.instagram.com/refresh_access_token with grant_type=ig_refresh_token once it is at least 24 hours old and unexpired. Tokens not refreshed within 60 days expire. The old business_* scope names are deprecated since 2025-01-27.

Observed (Meta Instagram get-started doc): identity comes from GET https://graph.instagram.com/v26.0/me?fields=user_id,username, and the examples pass the token as the access_token query parameter, so this file injects the query parameter.

UNVERIFIED: the docs fetched do not state redirect URI rules (https, localhost). Meta apps may require https outside Development mode; use an https tunnel via switchboard authconfig add ... --redirect-uri if the console rejects the loopback URI.
Publishing limits are stated as 100 posts per 24 hours in one section of the content publishing doc and 50 in another; check content_publishing_limit before publishing (ADR section 8).
Images must be reachable at a public URL (JPEG) unless the app uses Facebook Login for Business with resumable upload; that is the media staging decision in ADR section 6.6, not part of connecting.
